fusions.name: Kite-String Hoist
fusions.desc: Hooks a strand into the first enemy it meets. It deals 11 damage, carries the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Three on Creances
fusions.desc: Looses 3 hawks on lines at once, spread apart. Each hawk deals 6 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Woven Nest
fusions.desc: Weaves a nest of strands reaching 3 tiles around where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Line Paid Out
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
